I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random. The ticket is **#8841**. Tobias posted it in that same channel yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27): West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and he flagged it to support on #8841.

There's one thing I couldn't confirm. Tobias said the issue was on "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I'm assuming it's Fieldworks because the January handoff digest calls Fieldworks Pree's dealer account and says it changed hands on Jan 5. That digest doesn't say who took it over, though. I suggested she check with Tobias before the customer call.

I only used what Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and public files. There are no account ticket files in the share, so I couldn't look the ticket up there.
